metadata.Name: Jamp
metadata.Description: A Japanese NLI dataset for temporal inference, constructed using templates based on tense fragments.
Provider: The University of Texas at Austin
metadata.Paper Title: Jamp: Controlled Japanese Temporal Inference Dataset for Evaluating Generalization Capacity of Language Models
Affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin
metadata.Abstract: In this paper, we present oursno, which is a Japanese NLI dataset for temporal inference, and propose a method for automatic construction from templates based on tense fragments. We evaluate two Japanese models and one multilingual model on our dataset. The experimental results demonstrate that the LMs can generalize across different temporal expressions but fail to generalize some tense fragments such as habituality.
